name: Rage Veil Su
body:
Prerequisite(s): Barbarian or skald 6, elemental stance (unchained barbarian rage power), lesser elemental rage, or lesser elemental blood rage powers.

Benefit(s): When raging, the barbarian can use Stealth, and she gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her barbarian level on Stealth checks plus the benefits of concealment against ranged attacks and attacks of opportunity.
